I have been dealing with multiple health issues, one of them for over a year, and this GP practice has completely failed to provide proper care.

I am in ongoing pain, yet my appointments are repeatedly cancelled, sometimes on the same morning I am supposed to attend. This has happened multiple times. There is no continuity, no ownership, and no clear plan. I am constantly being sent back and forth, wasting time and energy while my symptoms remain unresolved.

Communication is extremely poor. Different members of staff say different things, often contradicting each other. I am told to attend appointments that then do not go ahead, including being sent for tests or procedures that are later not carried out despite being clearly indicated.

Recently, I contacted them again regarding a separate, new issue. I was sent back and forth between different services. This caused completely unnecessary visits, all while I was in pain and the test or procedure was medically justified.

While the staff are generally polite, patients are not treated as people with real pain and real urgency. There is a clear lack of understanding of how severe and persistent symptoms can be, and despite being in significant pain, I am repeatedly left without timely help or follow-up.

I am constantly told to use the eConsult form, but even when I do, I might wait up to two weeks for an appointment, which is then sometimes cancelled anyway. During this entire time, I am left in pain, unsupported, and without any clear next steps.

Overall, I cannot recommend this GP practice at all. I do not feel listened to, taken seriously, or cared for in any meaningful way. If you are looking for a GP who will actually investigate symptoms and understand the impact of ongoing pain, I would strongly advise looking elsewhere.
